purpose: Implement and CPU-test a fail-closed evaluator and paired Round A analyzer without loading real checkpoints or reading any dataset payload.

protocol_validator: validate protocol identity and SHA binding
validate exactly B0/A1/Q0/QC times Fold A/B times seed 0
validate completion receipt, runtime config, checkpoint and allowlist hashes before any checkpoint load or NPZ open
validate completion status TRAINING_AND_BNCAL_PASS and BNCal checkpoint selection
reject any unrecognized path, candidate, fold, seed, member, count or output target
evaluation_runner: process one checkpoint at a time in frozen order
force FP32, eval mode, torch.no_grad, batch size 1, workers 0 and exact allowlist order
open each allowlisted NPZ once per model-case and audit reads of partial, implant and gt
pass only partial to model forward
compute physical-space metrics using manifest centroid and scale
collect scalar-only SCQR mechanism diagnostics without saving prediction or raw instrumentation tensors
hash full model parameter and buffer state before and after all forwards and fail on any change
write exact payload, checkpoint-load, forward, optimizer and update counters
write per-model case metrics, per-model source metrics, mechanism diagnostics and an execution receipt
paired_analyzer: require all eight complete evaluation partitions before analysis
pair by fold, case_id and seed
aggregate five defect cases equally within each source skull
compute fold A, fold B and combined 42-source summaries
compute QC-minus-B0 before QC-minus-Q0 and report A1 secondarily
run deterministic 10000-sample source-skull cluster bootstrap with seed 20260910
never drop or nanmean nonfinite primary or guardrail values
apply the exact frozen Round A gate without changing thresholds
write paired deltas, summary and a non-authorizing gate receipt
contract_tests: use only synthetic in-memory records and temporary files
test matrix, path, hash, member and counter fail-closed behavior
test partial-only model input and post-forward-only metric target use
test source-skull aggregation, pairing and deterministic bootstrap
test every Round A pass and fail threshold boundary
test that a PASS result never grants Round B or any next-run authorization

explicitly_not_requested: modification of any existing source, config, training output or checkpoint
creation of the formal execution launcher
deserialization or model loading of any of the eight real checkpoints
confirmation20, official test, old monitor or MUG access
training, BNCal, optimizer construction or any model update
Round B, seed stability, intervention or subsequent run
required_post_implementation_evidence: SHA256 and byte size for each of the three new files
explicit zero counts for checkpoint loads, NPZ opens, GPU forwards, optimizer steps, parameter updates, buffer updates and development evaluations
a separate exact formal development-evaluation authorization request

failure_policy.test_failure: stop, report and preserve evidence; do not relax the protocol or run real evaluation

required_user_authorization: Explicitly authorize creation of only tools/run_cranial_scqr_v11_l4_round_a_dev_eval.py, tools/analyze_cranial_scqr_v11_l4_round_a.py and tools/test_cranial_scqr_v11_l4_round_a_dev_eval_contract.py according to the frozen protocol, followed only by syntax checks and synthetic CPU contract tests; prohibit modification of existing files, real checkpoint loading, NPZ access, GPU inference, development evaluation, real-result statistics, training, BNCal, formal launcher creation and any subsequent run.
